companies[2].note: This one comes in under the same yardstick: Ambev's margin really is high, and it would be dishonest to show only the thin cases. What the shopper does not see is the other side of the bill — with beer, a large share of the price of the can is tax before any margin at all.
sectorMargin.finding: In supermarkets, the sector's profit margin sits between 1% and 2%, according to the sector's own association. When someone says 'the shops are profiting from your hunger', they are talking about one cent per real.
dvaPending: Each company's DVA — the statement of value added, the table showing how much of the value created went to government, wages, banks and shareholders — is in the annual reports and is the next dataset to land here. We do not publish estimates: only the number the company published.
